body:
Just to add. On the private gitea instance token authentication was used when this error was thrown.

EDIT: Sorry. Just tried again it does indeed work. Maybe my token was lost for whatever reason when I got the error.

OK looking at your gist it appears that the issue was that the ctx.User was nil. Which would fit with your token being incorrect.

I'll pop up a PR to prevent the NPE though.
